description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a specific region.
The name of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-db-resource-pool --db-cluster-id am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --pool-name USER_DEFAULT --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
